mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome. Isn't it wild how fast-paced life gets—how easy it is to look for validation from our jobs, our communities, or even the people around us? But what if, deep down, the real secret to happiness and success is much more personal? Together, we're about to explore a different way of seeing things—one that James Altucher lays out in his book, Choose Yourself: Be Happy, Make Millions, Live the Dream. Instead of waiting for someone else to give us permission, Altucher invites us to start with the boldest move of all: choosing ourselves. Through honest stories about bouncing back from failure and finding new strength, he shows us how fulfillment isn’t handed out by gatekeepers or locked away in some perfect system. It starts with the courage to step off the usual path—trusting ourselves, embracing vulnerability, and investing in our own growth. We'll talk about practical ways to boost your emotional, physical, and financial well-being, all while letting go of the pressure to fit in. The lines between work, passion, and personal life are blurring, and that’s actually a good thing—it means you get to shape your own journey. So, if you’ve ever wondered whether happiness and success are really in your hands, you’re in the right place. Let’s dive in together and see how choosing yourself, again and again, can be the foundation for a life that’s not only meaningful, but truly abundant.
